question: The Mesopotamians wrote on tablets made of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__clay.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mesopotamians wrote on tablets made of **clay**.
 
• Mesopotamian civilization is the most ancient civilization recorded in human history until now.
 
• The name Mesopotamia is derived from the Greek word **mesos**, meaning middle and **potamos**, meaning river.
 
• Mesopotamia is a place situated in the middle of the **Euphrates and the Tigris rivers** which is now a part of Iraq.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It was in Mesopotamia that the earliest cities, the first urban civilization, appeared, about** 3500 BCE.**
 
• Some of the major Mesopotamian civilizations include the** Sumerian, Assyrian, Akkadian, and Babylonian civilizations**.
 
• In Mesopotamian civilization, the houses were built around distinct palaces and temples & dedicated to the patron Gods or Goddesses.
 
• **Mesopotamia and Indus Valley Civilization** can be called as contemporary civilizations as there were pieces of evidence of the trade between these civilizations which were found in excavations of Mohenjedaro.
 
• Mesopatamians society clearly ruled by a **king** whereas the Indus society was not ruled by a King maybe by a village head or others.
 
• The first city-states gradually develop in southern Mesopotamia in **5000-3500 BCE.** This is the achievement of the Sumerian people.
